title: 【OSHI NO KO】
description: OSHI NO KOA small-town doctor gets sucked into the ruthless world of show business when he crosses paths with a popular teen idol who holds a secret.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Stories are lies meant to entertain, and idols lie to fans eager to believe. This is Ai's story. It is a lie, but it is also true.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Ruby wants to be an idol for herself and for the little girl who died from cancer. The real world, however, doesn't care about big dreams: something Aqua knows all too well.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Aqua agrees to Kana's request, but not for the reason she wants. There's a connection between Masaya Kaburagi and Ai, which leads Aqua to the set of a TV drama for answers.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Kana's resolve remains strong despite her washed up reputation. Aqua sets the stage for her with a bold move that flips the script, which leads to opportunities for them both.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Despite different motivations, Aqua, Ruby and Kana’s key to success in the entertainment industry is the same; to achieve their goals, they need to play the game.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Remember what you said in righteous outrage online? There were consequences. You never saw them, but that didn't make them any less real, nor hold you any less accountable.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Left reeling in the immediate aftermath, Akane's costars unite in friendship and purpose: they will clear their friend's name. They owe her nothing less.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Focused on revenge, Aqua underestimated Akane and gave the talented actress a way to win his heart. If love is a game, Akane is playing for keeps and Kana is falling behind.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: MEM-cho won't let her second chance go to waste and uses her influence to help grow B Komachi's brand. Meanwhile, Aqua's investigation into Ai's past bears fruit.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: B Komachi's first performance approaches, but the group still needs practice while Kana refuses to be the center. Perhaps a certain expert choreographer could help them shine?

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: MEM-cho has fans. Ruby has looks. But Kana has...? She’ll need to find the answer before she can be anyone's star. Later, a fresh opportunity sets Aqua on a new path to revenge.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: The stage is set. The actors are ready. And the curtain rises on the play, Tokyo Blade. However, there is another story aside from the play: that of the actors themselves.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Six months have passed since the release of B-Komachi's music video, and lots of things have changed.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Ruby starts to make her mark as reporter on Dig Deep!

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Things go horribly wrong at the Comiket shoot. Can Dig Deep come back from this?

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Aqua confronts Ruby and starts to piece together the puzzle.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Kana's at the end of her rope and decides to try to get back into acting.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Kana's encounter with Shima looms over her and the rest of Strawberry Productions.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Kana has bounced back, but the scandal still looms large.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Aqua has to face the aftermath of his decision to reveal Ai's secret.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: As the movie project kicks into gear, Masaya Kaburagi goes to work, putting both sides of himself on show.

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: How will Ruby and Akane act out the theme of liar? And how will the audition end?

episodes_data.title: 【OSHI NO KO】 Season 3 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Aqua has a very surprising encounter, and Ruby is close to succumbing under all the pressure.
